subject: Partner catalog revenue routing & lead attribution — playbook proposal
messages:
From: Rajiv Malhotra <rajiv@cloudresell.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Partner catalog revenue routing & lead attribution — proposal

Hi Irene / Ben,

Thanks again for the call this morning. As discussed, CloudResell is ready to go live with the Nimbus Analytics listing and we want to confirm how marketplace revenue routing and co-sell attribution will flow across AWS and GCP. Attached is a short proposal (revenue-routing-proposal.pdf) plus a CSV with the SKU-to-ledger mapping (routing-mapping.csv).

High-level asks from our side:
- Confirm how Marketplace invoices map to Redwood product SKUs and where partner commissions are recorded.
- Define lead attribution flow (Marketplace lead -> Redwood account team -> CloudResell) so commissions and co-sell credits are reconciled.
- SLA/retainer mechanics for co-sell support and any pass-through credits.

Can you review and let us know what additional evidence you need for your listing/security review? Also curious whether Redwood prefers a single ledger (Redwood-managed) or partner-managed payout.

Proposed next step: 30-minute ops sync this week to finalize mapping and resource owners.

Thanks,
Rajiv
CloudResell Partnerships

Attachment: revenue-routing-proposal.pdf (summary, 3 pages)
Attachment: routing-mapping.csv (SKU mapping sample)

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Rajiv Malhotra <rajiv@cloudresell.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner catalog revenue routing & lead attribution — proposal

Rajiv — thanks, received and skimmed the attachments. A few clarifying points before we schedule the sync:

1) Ledger model: Redwood typically prefers to manage the primary ledger for hosted listings (simpler for tax and reporting), but for certain resellers we support partner-managed payouts with a weekly settlement feed. We need to know if CloudResell needs immediate self-payout or can accept Redwood-managed commission settlements.

2) Attribution: Do you expect to use HubSpot UTM-based attribution or Marketplace-provided referral IDs? We need examples of the referral IDs that Nimbus will surface so we can wire them into our lead routing hook.

3) Evidence and compliance: For Marketplace listing approvals we will need one-page proof of the technical integration (SaaS-on-Marketplace doc) and a co-sell retainer term sheet (I see a draft in your packet — please confirm).

If Ben and Vivek can confirm Redwood-side owners for ledger, finance handoff, and the CS contact that will own co-sell enablement, we can lock in a time. I put potential owners below.

Proposed Redwood owners:
- Ledger / Finance integration: Ben Carter
- Co-sell enablement / GTM: Vivek Kulkarni
- Listing technical evidence: Irene Choi

Available times for a 30-min sync: Tue 9/1 11:00-11:30 PDT, Wed 9/2 14:00-14:30 PDT. Which works?

—Irene
Head of Partner Integrations, Redwood Inference

Thanks Rajiv, Irene.

We can own the Redwood-managed ledger for this listing. Quick notes:
- Finance needs SKU metadata (product_id, sku_code, marketplace_listing_id) + expected monthly ARR per SKU to configure the payout schedule. routing-mapping.csv is a good start but we need the full catalog extract.
- For partner-managed payouts, legal requires the co-sell retainer term sheet (co-sell-retainer-term-sheet.docx) + an MSA addendum. If CloudResell prefers partner-managed we will route to Legal.
- For attribution, we can support both UTM and Marketplace referral IDs but prefer a referral ID as the primary canonical key. We will wire it into our lead routing if your ops team can guarantee stable referral IDs per offer.

Attaching: sample_payout_template.xlsx (stub) and a one-page checklist that Finance uses for ledger mapping (Attachment: ledger-checklist.pdf).

Action items I will own before the sync:
1) Share Redwood payout template and checklist to CloudResell ops. (attachment: ledger-checklist.pdf)
2) Confirm weekly settlement cadence for Redwood-managed ledger (default: weekly net-14).
3) Add Laura Bennett to the legal loop for partner-managed flow.

Irene — either Wed 9/2 14:00 PDT works for me.

—Ben
Head of Platform Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: ledger-checklist.pdf, sample_payout_template.xlsx

Ben / Irene,

Appreciate the quick turn. Nimbus is comfortable with Redwood managing the primary ledger (that simplifies us). We're happy to provide the full catalog extract by EOD tomorrow — will include product_id and estimated ARR.

For attribution, Nimbus will surface a stable "referral_id" per offer; I'll include the format in the catalog extract. The co-sell retainer term sheet looks fine but we have two minor asks: 1) a 60-day review clause for commission percentages, and 2) a section clarifying which party bears chargeback risk for refunds processed by the marketplace. We'll mark those in the doc and return.

Confirmed: Wed 9/2 14:00 PDT for the sync. I'll forward the attachments in a follow-up.

Thanks,
Rajiv

- CloudResell requests two clarifications in the retainer: 60-day commission review clause + chargeback responsibility. Laura will review contract language.
